<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-reference.mjs from inventory/atoms.json. Do not edit by hand. -->
Factory settings are one revisioned document per tenant. Change them on the console's Factory settings page or with `PUT /v1/factory/settings`. Keys stored on **sandbox** belong to the Pix Sandbox and are edited here for convenience. A key marked **locked** cannot be changed.

Sections: [agents](#agents) · [approve](#approve) · [audit](#audit) · [autonomy](#autonomy) · [belai](#belai) · [budget](#budget) · [crews](#crews) · [defaults](#defaults) · [delivery](#delivery) · [other](#other) · [github](#github) · [hosts](#hosts) · [jail](#jail) · [kanban](#kanban) · [notify](#notify) · [persistence](#persistence) · [pix](#pix) · [providers](#providers) · [schedules](#schedules) · [scope](#scope) · [security](#security) · [signing](#signing) · [systemone](#systemone) · [tea](#tea) · [vault](#vault)
